data_policy: Strict verification from official competition organizers and open betting tip directories. No hallucinations. Missing factors are documented explicitly.

irregularities.title: OLBG HTML lacks machine-readable odds attributes
irregularities.detail: OLBG server HTML includes consensus ratios and market labels but no machine-readable decimal/American odds attributes. Odds are cross-referenced against standard market consensus.
irregularities.mitigation: Scoring engine penalizes unpriced factors and caps confidence appropriately.

irregularities.title: Early season goal samples for promoted teams
irregularities.detail: Early season matches may have smaller sample sizes for newly promoted teams like KIF Kolding or Skive FH.
irregularities.mitigation: The engine factors in prior tier performance and historical H2H records with proper weighting.

irregularities.title: Bundesliga and Danish clubs on OLBG that are not in the committed roster
irregularities.detail: OLBG Handball listings regularly include SC Magdeburg, Füchse Berlin, ThSV Eisenach, HBW Balingen-Weilstetten, HSV Hamburg, TVB Stuttgart and GOG. Those clubs are not in data/handball_teams.json or data/handball_matches.json because no free, key-less standings/results feed for those sides has been collected into this snapshot. The current tape covers the sourced HBL, Herreligaen, LNH and REMA 1000-ligaen clubs listed in the teams file (Kiel, Lemgo, Flensburg, Aalborg, Montpellier, and the rest of that roster).
irregularities.mitigation: Do not invent Magdeburg/Füchse/GOG fixtures or form. Score only sourced matches. Surface this gap on the Data Quality tab. Expand the roster only after an official table or result tape is committed.
